confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on aggregated Cairo prices surfaced in search (Numbeo and Citycost, dated Oct 2026; Expatistan; plus mixed hotel menus and blogs), converted at roughly 52-53 EGP per USD. Meals and coffee track the aggregates closely. Beer is set above Numbeo's crowd-sourced draft price (about EGP 78, range 50-200) to reflect licensed, tourist-facing venues (New Cairo about EGP 150; hotel drafts EGP 200+). Cocktail and wine evidence is thin (crowd-sourced figures and mostly undated hotel menus), so they were set from the local relationship to beer (about 2.4x and 2.1x) and sanity-checked against those listings. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge for a low-season July 2026 window; no accommodation searches or live listings were inspected, so they are the least certain. EGP volatility and mixed source dates add uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: No proxy city was needed for food and drink: Cairo-specific aggregates were used directly. Accommodation is a general-knowledge estimate for Cairo's budget-to-mid-range tourist market (Downtown, Giza, Zamalek), typical of lower-cost North African and Middle Eastern tourist capitals.
